Dies hilft der App zu erkennen, wenn eine nicht autorisierte App geöffnet wird. „Zugriff auf Nutzungsdaten“ User Activity Detection for SOS The Auto Emergency Call (SOS) feature requires the Accessibility Service to detect if you are still using your phone. By recording only the time of your last touch interaction, the app can identify periods of abnormal inactivity and automatically trigger rescue calls to your emergency contacts. 

We are committed to absolute privacy: 
• DOES NOT read or collect screen content.
• DOES NOT record typed text or passwords.
• DOES NOT inspect other apps or change system settings.
• DOES NOT perform gestures or click buttons.
All activity timestamp data is stored securely on this device and used solely for emergency rescue purposes. DOES NOT read or collect screen content, record typed text, or interfere with personal settings SOS User Activity Detection Detects touch interactions to identify inactivity for Auto SOS calls. This service is used exclusively by the Auto Emergency Call (SOS) feature to monitor whether the phone is being actively used. It listens only for touch interaction events to update a "last active" timestamp on the device. This allows the app to detect abnormal inactivity. The service DOES NOT read screen content, DOES NOT collect text, DOES NOT track other apps, DOES NOT perform gestures, and DOES NOT share any data outside the device.
